statement: Let S and X be Noetherian schemes [def-pc-scheme], let f:X\to S be flat [def-weil-flat-morphism] and proper [def-weil-proper-morphism] of finite presentation, and let P=X\times_S X with projections pr_1,pr_2. Suppose a is a right adjoint to Rf_* and b is a right adjoint to R(pr_2)_* on quasi-coherent derived categories [def-pc-derived-category]. Then there is a canonical isomorphism b(\mathcal O_X)\cong L\operatorname{pr}_1^*a(\mathcal O_S) in the derived category of quasi-coherent complexes on P, where L pr_1^* is the derived pullback [def-pc-derived-pullback]. Choose localizations defining the derived categories only for X, S and P, with no family for unrelated schemes. The functor preservation and structure-sheaf membership witnesses serve only to type the restrictions to D_QCoh.

title: Self-product right-adjoint base change with local derived categories

from.place: second step: identify b(O_X) with L pr_1^* a(O_S)

proof.text: Apply Stacks Tag 0AAB to the self-product square with g=f; Noetherian schemes are qcqs, and f is proper flat of finite presentation. Evaluate its right-adjoint base-change isomorphism at O_S. Identify Lf^*O_S with O_X using pullback of the tensor unit, then transport through b and invert. For the chosen local derived categories, localization universal properties give equivalences commuting with the derived functors and degree-zero objects, and uniqueness of right adjoints transports the isomorphism to a and b. The result concerns only X, S, P and remains valid for identity maps and empty schemes. This is the second step of Tag 0E2P, independent of the diagonal adjunction-composition step.

theorem diagonal_baseChange_upperShriek_local
    {X S : Scheme.{u}} [IsNoetherian X] [IsNoetherian S]
    [HasDerivedCategory.{w} (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings X.toRingedSpace))]
    [HasDerivedCategory.{w} (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings S.toRingedSpace))]
    (f : X ⟶ S) [Flat f] [IsProper f] [LocallyOfFinitePresentation f]
    [HasDerivedCategory.{w} (SheafOfModules.{u}
      (moduleRings (Limits.pullback f f).toRingedSpace))]
    (hRf : ∀ E : schemeDerivedQCohCategory X,
      schemeDerivedQCohProperty S ((schemeDerivedDirectImage f).obj E.obj))
    (hRpr₂ : ∀ E : schemeDerivedQCohCategory (Limits.pullback f f),
      schemeDerivedQCohProperty X
        ((schemeDerivedDirectImage (pullback.snd f f)).obj E.obj))
    (hLpr₁ : ∀ E : schemeDerivedQCohCategory X,
      schemeDerivedQCohProperty (Limits.pullback f f)
        ((derivedPullback (pullback.fst f f)).obj E.obj))
    (hOX : schemeDerivedQCohProperty X
      ((DerivedCategory.singleFunctor
        (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings X.toRingedSpace)) 0).obj
        (SheafOfModules.unit (moduleRings X.toRingedSpace))))
    (hOS : schemeDerivedQCohProperty S
      ((DerivedCategory.singleFunctor
        (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings S.toRingedSpace)) 0).obj
        (SheafOfModules.unit (moduleRings S.toRingedSpace))))
    (a : schemeDerivedQCohCategory S ⥤ schemeDerivedQCohCategory X)
    (b : schemeDerivedQCohCategory X ⥤ schemeDerivedQCohCategory (Limits.pullback f f))
    (adjA : (schemeDerivedQCohProperty S).lift
      ((schemeDerivedQCohProperty X).ι ⋙ schemeDerivedDirectImage f) hRf ⊣ a)
    (adjB : (schemeDerivedQCohProperty X).lift
      ((schemeDerivedQCohProperty (Limits.pullback f f)).ι ⋙
        schemeDerivedDirectImage (pullback.snd f f)) hRpr₂ ⊣ b) :
    Nonempty
      (b.obj ⟨(DerivedCategory.singleFunctor
          (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings X.toRingedSpace)) 0).obj
          (SheafOfModules.unit (moduleRings X.toRingedSpace)), hOX⟩ ≅
        ((schemeDerivedQCohProperty (Limits.pullback f f)).lift
          ((schemeDerivedQCohProperty X).ι ⋙ derivedPullback (pullback.fst f f))
          hLpr₁).obj (a.obj
            ⟨(DerivedCategory.singleFunctor
              (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings S.toRingedSpace)) 0).obj
              (SheafOfModules.unit (moduleRings S.toRingedSpace)), hOS⟩))
